newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai finance firms to receive more licenses.
newsitem.headline: Thai finance firms to receive more licenses.

text.p: Thailand's council of economic ministers on Monday approved a plan to award additional licences to some finance firms in order to allow them do more financial businesses, government spokesman said.

The move, proposed by the finance ministry, is also aimed at strengthening the stability of Thai financial institutions and promoting the separation of finance firms' securities and finance businesses, the spokesman told reporters.
There are currently nine finance or finance and securities companies which are not licenced to do certain financial services like corporate finance and consumer financing, he said.
